goals.evidence: Implemented evidence-based release readiness with source/timestamp-bound BOM cost, firmware build and exact-tier test evidence; explicit simulation/bench/HIL/physical-device bindings; deterministic READY/BLOCKED report; target protocol schema, firmware source/build artifact, BOM snapshot membership, freshness, and assessment/retest provenance validation. ./forge verify passed Ruff, format, strict mypy, lock/pip checks, 139 tests, and 90% branch coverage. Independent adversarial re-review found no P0/P1 and approved checkpoint; append-only ReleaseDecision persistence remains a G005 P2/WATCH required before G007.

goals.title: Secure integration and release API
goals.objective: Expose change intake, connector snapshots, consistency findings, required retests, evidence ingestion, and release decisions through a secure loopback API; define adapter boundaries for CAD, PLM, Git, and CI without becoming a source-of-truth replacement, and retain idempotency, optimistic concurrency, Origin/Host/CSRF/content-type/body-limit protections.
goals.steeringEvidence: User positioned FORGE as a connecting verification layer for existing engineering systems.
goals.steeringRationale: The API must center change-management and release evidence rather than generic spec execution.
goals.evidence: Implemented secure loopback engineering release API with read-only CAD/PLM/Git/CI connector boundaries and persisted capture provenance; immutable per-project release policy with v1/v2->v3 backfill; project-scoped append-only raw evidence and decisions; canonical hash binding for policy and selected evidence; idempotency, optimistic concurrency, exact Host/Origin/CSRF/content-type/body limits; BOM policy/timestamp ambiguity fail-closed. ./forge verify passed Ruff, strict mypy, lock/pip checks, 164 tests and 90% total branch coverage. Two independent final reviewers returned GO with no P0/P1.

goals.title: Engineering release readiness dashboard
goals.objective: Build a thin operator interface showing hardware revision deltas, cross-artifact mismatches, automatically required retests, provenance-bound BOM prices, firmware/build/test evidence, explicit simulation-versus-bench-versus-HIL-versus-device tiers, and release-ready or blocked decisions with drill-down reasons.
goals.steeringEvidence: User explicitly requested evidence-based release readiness and clear separation of verification environments.
goals.steeringRationale: The operator experience should answer what changed, what is inconsistent, what must be rerun, and why release is blocked.
goals.evidence: Implemented a thin read-only engineering release dashboard at /app/ with hardware deltas, cross-artifact findings, auto-retests, provenance-bound BOM quotes/timestamps, firmware build/test evidence, explicit static/simulation/bench/HIL/physical-device lanes, READY/BLOCKED reasons, and canonical hash drill-down. Loopback-only server uses strict Host/Origin validation, asset allowlist, CSP without inline code, safe DOM rendering, and packaged same-origin assets. Browser QA verified READY, BLOCKED, not_found, 1440px and 390px layouts with no horizontal overflow or console errors. Wheel asset inclusion verified. ./forge verify passed Ruff, strict mypy, lock/pip checks, 170 tests and 90% coverage. Two independent final reviewers returned GO with no P0/P1 after project-ID contract regression fix.

goals.title: Change-management release quality gates

goals.steeringEvidence: The new product promise is preventing engineering release omissions, so final quality must prove end-to-end traceability and conservative gating.
goals.steeringRationale: Final gates must validate the repositioned B2B release workflow rather than generic AI engineering capability.

goals.title: Baseline and contracts
goals.objective: Lock the existing deterministic behavior, add only required dependencies, initialize safe local project metadata, and define versioned domain contracts for specifications, approvals, prepared analyses, and lifecycle events.
goals.evidence: 72 tests passed; 96% branch coverage; Ruff, mypy, lock check, pip check passed; immutable ApprovalRef, PreparedAnalysis, and append-only RunStateEvent contracts added; Git baseline commit 997621c created.

goals.title: Two-stage analysis engine
goals.objective: Split analysis into durable prepare and execute_prepared stages while preserving the existing execute wrapper; bind preflight to spec, revision, policy, engine, plugin, expected metrics, and approvals; reject stale or tampered preparation before plugin execution.
goals.evidence: 83 tests passed; 96% branch coverage; Ruff, formatting, mypy, lock and pip checks passed; independent re-review APPROVE; durable prepare/execute_prepared binding rejects stale or tampered state before plugin execution.

goals.title: SQLite evidence store
goals.objective: Implement migration-managed SQLite persistence for projects, specs, revisions, approvals, prepared analyses, append-only run events, results, idempotency, optimistic concurrency, startup recovery, and byte-stable evidence export.
goals.evidence: Implemented migration-managed SQLite persistence with WAL/FK/bounded retries, optimistic CAS, atomic domain+idempotency transactions, immutable specs/revisions/approvals/preparations/run events/results/evidence, validated startup-recovery discovery, corrupt row/payload rejection, and byte-stable snapshot export. ./forge verify passed: Ruff, strict mypy, lock checks, 102 tests, 93% total coverage. Independent code review APPROVE and architecture verification CLEAR.

goals.title: Application workflow service
goals.objective: Implement the only state-transition and engineering-evaluation owner, including draft-to-approved specs, revision-aware invalidation, prepared run orchestration without holding a database transaction during plugin execution, retry, cancellation boundaries, cost provenance, and maturity gating.
goals.steeringEvidence: User explicitly repositioned FORGE as an engineering change-management AI and evidence-based release validation layer connecting CAD, PLM, Git, and CI instead of a general AI engineer.
goals.steeringRationale: The active general workflow-service story is too broad and product-misaligned; replace it with focused domain, impact-analysis, and release-readiness stories while preserving completed deterministic contracts and persistence.

goals.title: Engineering change domain and positioning
goals.objective: Reframe FORGE as the validation layer connecting existing CAD, PLM, Git, and CI; define versioned contracts and source-of-truth documentation for hardware revisions, cross-artifact consistency findings, retest requirements, evidence tiers, and release decisions without replacing authoring systems.
goals.evidence: PRD v4 and README now define FORGE as a read-only validation layer connecting CAD/PLM/Git/CI; forge_core/change_management.py adds source snapshots, cross-domain impacts, findings, explicit evidence tiers, retest requirements, and deterministic READY/BLOCKED contracts; ./forge verify passed 110 tests with 91% total branch coverage.

goals.title: Cross-artifact change impact engine
goals.objective: Detect hardware revision changes and deterministically map them to affected firmware, BOM, tests, protocol schemas, and documentation; validate pins, voltage, units, command ranges, and protocol compatibility; automatically assign required retests with explicit reasons.
goals.evidence: forge_core/impact_engine.py implements deterministic source-bound hardware revision delta detection, cross-artifact pin/voltage/unit/command/schema validation, fail-closed policy coverage, and exact-tier automatic retest assignment; tests/test_impact_engine.py covers 20 adversarial cases; ./forge verify passed 130 tests with 91% total coverage; independent re-review found no P0/P1 and judged G009 checkpoint-ready (one non-blocking P2: one canonical projection per domain).

goals.title: Evidence-based release readiness service
goals.objective: Collect source- and timestamp-bound BOM prices, firmware build and test results, and distinctly typed simulation, bench, HIL, and physical-device evidence; issue release-ready or blocked decisions with traceable blockers and a reproducible report.
goals.evidence: Implemented evidence-based release readiness with source/timestamp-bound BOM cost, firmware build and exact-tier test evidence; explicit simulation/bench/HIL/physical-device bindings; deterministic READY/BLOCKED report; target protocol schema, firmware source/build artifact, BOM snapshot membership, freshness, and assessment/retest provenance validation. ./forge verify passed Ruff, format, strict mypy, lock/pip checks, 139 tests, and 90% branch coverage. Independent adversarial re-review found no P0/P1 and approved checkpoint; append-only ReleaseDecision persistence remains a G005 P2/WATCH required before G007.

goals.title: Secure integration and release API
goals.objective: Expose change intake, connector snapshots, consistency findings, required retests, evidence ingestion, and release decisions through a secure loopback API; define adapter boundaries for CAD, PLM, Git, and CI without becoming a source-of-truth replacement, and retain idempotency, optimistic concurrency, Origin/Host/CSRF/content-type/body-limit protections.
goals.steeringEvidence: User positioned FORGE as a connecting verification layer for existing engineering systems.
goals.steeringRationale: The API must center change-management and release evidence rather than generic spec execution.
goals.evidence: Implemented secure loopback engineering release API with read-only CAD/PLM/Git/CI connector boundaries and persisted capture provenance; immutable per-project release policy with v1/v2->v3 backfill; project-scoped append-only raw evidence and decisions; canonical hash binding for policy and selected evidence; idempotency, optimistic concurrency, exact Host/Origin/CSRF/content-type/body limits; BOM policy/timestamp ambiguity fail-closed. ./forge verify passed Ruff, strict mypy, lock/pip checks, 164 tests and 90% total branch coverage. Two independent final reviewers returned GO with no P0/P1.

goals.title: Engineering release readiness dashboard
goals.objective: Build a thin operator interface showing hardware revision deltas, cross-artifact mismatches, automatically required retests, provenance-bound BOM prices, firmware/build/test evidence, explicit simulation-versus-bench-versus-HIL-versus-device tiers, and release-ready or blocked decisions with drill-down reasons.
goals.steeringEvidence: User explicitly requested evidence-based release readiness and clear separation of verification environments.
goals.steeringRationale: The operator experience should answer what changed, what is inconsistent, what must be rerun, and why release is blocked.
goals.evidence: Implemented a thin read-only engineering release dashboard at /app/ with hardware deltas, cross-artifact findings, auto-retests, provenance-bound BOM quotes/timestamps, firmware build/test evidence, explicit static/simulation/bench/HIL/physical-device lanes, READY/BLOCKED reasons, and canonical hash drill-down. goals.evidence: Implemented evidence-based release readiness with source/timestamp-bound BOM cost, firmware build and exact-tier test evidence; explicit simulation/bench/HIL/physical-device bindings; deterministic READY/BLOCKED report; target protocol schema, firmware source/build artifact, BOM snapshot membership, freshness, and assessment/retest provenance validation. ./forge verify passed Ruff, format, strict mypy, lock/pip checks, 139 tests, and 90% branch coverage. Independent adversarial re-review found no P0/P1 and approved checkpoint; append-only ReleaseDecision persistence remains a G005 P2/WATCH required before G007.

goals.title: Secure integration and release API
goals.objective: Expose change intake, connector snapshots, consistency findings, required retests, evidence ingestion, and release decisions through a secure loopback API; define adapter boundaries for CAD, PLM, Git, and CI without becoming a source-of-truth replacement, and retain idempotency, optimistic concurrency, Origin/Host/CSRF/content-type/body-limit protections.
goals.steeringEvidence: User positioned FORGE as a connecting verification layer for existing engineering systems.
goals.steeringRationale: The API must center change-management and release evidence rather than generic spec execution.
goals.evidence: Implemented secure loopback engineering release API with read-only CAD/PLM/Git/CI connector boundaries and persisted capture provenance; immutable per-project release policy with v1/v2->v3 backfill; project-scoped append-only raw evidence and decisions; canonical hash binding for policy and selected evidence; idempotency, optimistic concurrency, exact Host/Origin/CSRF/content-type/body limits; BOM policy/timestamp ambiguity fail-closed. ./forge verify passed Ruff, strict mypy, lock/pip checks, 164 tests and 90% total branch coverage. Two independent final reviewers returned GO with no P0/P1.

goals.title: Engineering release readiness dashboard
goals.objective: Build a thin operator interface showing hardware revision deltas, cross-artifact mismatches, automatically required retests, provenance-bound BOM prices, firmware/build/test evidence, explicit simulation-versus-bench-versus-HIL-versus-device tiers, and release-ready or blocked decisions with drill-down reasons.
goals.steeringEvidence: User explicitly requested evidence-based release readiness and clear separation of verification environments.
goals.steeringRationale: The operator experience should answer what changed, what is inconsistent, what must be rerun, and why release is blocked.
goals.evidence: Implemented a thin read-only engineering release dashboard at /app/ with hardware deltas, cross-artifact findings, auto-retests, provenance-bound BOM quotes/timestamps, firmware build/test evidence, explicit static/simulation/bench/HIL/physical-device lanes, READY/BLOCKED reasons, and canonical hash drill-down. Loopback-only server uses strict Host/Origin validation, asset allowlist, CSP without inline code, safe DOM rendering, and packaged same-origin assets. Browser QA verified READY, BLOCKED, not_found, 1440px and 390px layouts with no horizontal overflow or console errors. Wheel asset inclusion verified. ./forge verify passed Ruff, strict mypy, lock/pip checks, 170 tests and 90% coverage. Two independent final reviewers returned GO with no P0/P1 after project-ID contract regression fix.

goals.evidence: Implemented evidence-based release readiness with source/timestamp-bound BOM cost, firmware build and exact-tier test evidence; explicit simulation/bench/HIL/physical-device bindings; deterministic READY/BLOCKED report; target protocol schema, firmware source/build artifact, BOM snapshot membership, freshness, and assessment/retest provenance validation. ./forge verify passed Ruff, format, strict mypy, lock/pip checks, 139 tests, and 90% branch coverage. goals.title: Secure integration and release API
goals.objective: Expose change intake, connector snapshots, consistency findings, required retests, evidence ingestion, and release decisions through a secure loopback API; define adapter boundaries for CAD, PLM, Git, and CI without becoming a source-of-truth replacement, and retain idempotency, optimistic concurrency, Origin/Host/CSRF/content-type/body-limit protections.
goals.steeringEvidence: User positioned FORGE as a connecting verification layer for existing engineering systems.
goals.steeringRationale: The API must center change-management and release evidence rather than generic spec execution.
goals.evidence: Implemented secure loopback engineering release API with read-only CAD/PLM/Git/CI connector boundaries and persisted capture provenance; immutable per-project release policy with v1/v2->v3 backfill; project-scoped append-only raw evidence and decisions; canonical hash binding for policy and selected evidence; idempotency, optimistic concurrency, exact Host/Origin/CSRF/content-type/body limits; BOM policy/timestamp ambiguity fail-closed. ./forge verify passed Ruff, strict mypy, lock/pip checks, 164 tests and 90% total branch coverage. Two independent final reviewers returned GO with no P0/P1.

goals.title: Engineering release readiness dashboard
goals.objective: Build a thin operator interface showing hardware revision deltas, cross-artifact mismatches, automatically required retests, provenance-bound BOM prices, firmware/build/test evidence, explicit simulation-versus-bench-versus-HIL-versus-device tiers, and release-ready or blocked decisions with drill-down reasons.
goals.steeringEvidence: User explicitly requested evidence-based release readiness and clear separation of verification environments.
goals.steeringRationale: The operator experience should answer what changed, what is inconsistent, what must be rerun, and why release is blocked.
goals.evidence: Implemented a thin read-only engineering release dashboard at /app/ with hardware deltas, cross-artifact findings, auto-retests, provenance-bound BOM quotes/timestamps, firmware build/test evidence, explicit static/simulation/bench/HIL/physical-device lanes, READY/BLOCKED reasons, and canonical hash drill-down. Wheel asset inclusion verified. ./forge verify passed Ruff, strict mypy, lock/pip checks, 170 tests and 90% coverage. Two independent final reviewers returned GO with no P0/P1 after project-ID contract regression fix.

goals.evidence: forge_core/impact_engine.py implements deterministic source-bound hardware revision delta detection, cross-artifact pin/voltage/unit/command/schema validation, fail-closed policy coverage, and exact-tier automatic retest assignment; tests/test_impact_engine.py covers 20 adversarial cases; ./forge verify passed 130 tests with 91% total coverage; independent re-review found no P0/P1 and judged G009 checkpoint-ready (one non-blocking P2: one canonical projection per domain).

goals.title: Evidence-based release readiness service
goals.objective: Collect source- and timestamp-bound BOM prices, firmware build and test results, and distinctly typed simulation, bench, HIL, and physical-device evidence; issue release-ready or blocked decisions with traceable blockers and a reproducible report.
goals.evidence: Implemented evidence-based release readiness with source/timestamp-bound BOM cost, firmware build and exact-tier test evidence; explicit simulation/bench/HIL/physical-device bindings; deterministic READY/BLOCKED report; target protocol schema, firmware source/build artifact, BOM snapshot membership, freshness, and assessment/retest provenance validation. ./forge verify passed Ruff, format, strict mypy, lock/pip checks, 139 tests, and 90% branch coverage. Independent adversarial re-review found no P0/P1 and approved checkpoint; append-only ReleaseDecision persistence remains a G005 P2/WATCH required before G007.

goals.title: Secure integration and release API
goals.objective: Expose change intake, connector snapshots, consistency findings, required retests, evidence ingestion, and release decisions through a secure loopback API; define adapter boundaries for CAD, PLM, Git, and CI without becoming a source-of-truth replacement, and retain idempotency, optimistic concurrency, Origin/Host/CSRF/content-type/body-limit protections.
goals.steeringEvidence: User positioned FORGE as a connecting verification layer for existing engineering systems.
goals.steeringRationale: The API must center change-management and release evidence rather than generic spec execution.
goals.evidence: Implemented secure loopback engineering release API with read-only CAD/PLM/Git/CI connector boundaries and persisted capture provenance; immutable per-project release policy with v1/v2->v3 backfill; project-scoped append-only raw evidence and decisions; canonical hash binding for policy and selected evidence; idempotency, optimistic concurrency, exact Host/Origin/CSRF/content-type/body limits; BOM policy/timestamp ambiguity fail-closed. ./forge verify passed Ruff, strict mypy, lock/pip checks, 164 tests and 90% total branch coverage. Two independent final reviewers returned GO with no P0/P1.

goals.title: Engineering release readiness dashboard
goals.objective: Build a thin operator interface showing hardware revision deltas, cross-artifact mismatches, automatically required retests, provenance-bound BOM prices, firmware/build/test evidence, explicit simulation-versus-bench-versus-HIL-versus-device tiers, and release-ready or blocked decisions with drill-down reasons.
goals.steeringEvidence: User explicitly requested evidence-based release readiness and clear separation of verification environments.
goals.steeringRationale: The operator experience should answer what changed, what is inconsistent, what must be rerun, and why release is blocked.
goals.evidence: Implemented a thin read-only engineering release dashboard at /app/ with hardware deltas, cross-artifact findings, auto-retests, provenance-bound BOM quotes/timestamps, firmware build/test evidence, explicit static/simulation/bench/HIL/physical-device lanes, READY/BLOCKED reasons, and canonical hash drill-down. Loopback-only server uses strict Host/Origin validation, asset allowlist, CSP without inline code, safe DOM rendering, and packaged same-origin assets. Browser QA verified READY, BLOCKED, not_found, 1440px and 390px layouts with no horizontal overflow or console errors. Wheel asset inclusion verified. ./forge verify passed Ruff, strict mypy, lock/pip checks, 170 tests and 90% coverage. Two independent final reviewers returned GO with no P0/P1 after project-ID contract regression fix.

goals.evidence: Fixed direct-open styling with an explicit safe file-preview mode; added immutable SQLite v7 candidate, simulation, claim and transition ledgers plus secure API routes; connected guided UI mutations with retry-safe server-backed state; validated claim and VERIFIED transition evidence by project/session in service and atomic storage; browser QA passed; ./forge verify passed 195 tests, strict mypy, Ruff, lock/pip checks and 90% coverage; independent code review APPROVE and architect CLEAR.

goals.title: Authorization enforcement and audit persistence
goals.objective: Integrate organization, actor, membership, project access, RBAC and append-only audit events into SQLite/service/loopback API so protected project operations fail closed and are queryable, with migrations and regression tests.
goals.evidence: SQLite schema v8 persists orgs, actors, memberships, project access and append-only audit events; service/API enforce RBAC fail-closed with local bootstrap identity and queryable allowed/denied audit trail; ./forge verify passed 227 tests, Ruff, strict mypy, lock/pip checks and 90% coverage.

goals.title: Operational health backup and restore
goals.objective: Implement deployment-test operational foundations: deep health/readiness reporting, safe SQLite backup with integrity verification, restore verification without destructive overwrite, and tests/documentation.
goals.evidence: Added hash-bound SQLite operational health, integrity/schema/migration readiness endpoint, verified backup creation, SHA-256 verification and non-overwriting restore-to-new-database flow; ./forge verify passed 232 tests and 90% coverage with Ruff, strict mypy and lock checks.

goals.title: Local source-grounded RAG vertical slice
goals.objective: Implement a no-network production-shaped local RAG vertical slice that ingests project-scoped text artifacts, retrieves deterministic cited chunks, invokes a bounded provider interface, persists runtime evidence where appropriate, and exposes a secure loopback API plus UI flow without granting release authority.
goals.evidence: Implemented bounded project-scoped UTF-8 ingestion, deterministic lexical retrieval, no-network extractive provider, persisted runtime results, secure RBAC API routes, and chat UI citation flow without release authority; ./forge verify passed Ruff, strict mypy, lock/pip checks, 238 tests and 90% coverage.

goals.title: STL ingestion and contextual 3D viewer
goals.objective: Implement safe ASCII/binary STL parsing with bounded resource validation, immutable artifact metadata and a dependency-free contextual 3D viewer path, preserving clear provenance and no CAD writeback; add tests and UI integration.
goals.evidence: Implemented strict bounded ASCII/binary STL parsing, finite-coordinate and exact-length validation, source/content/geometry/asset hash contracts, SQLite v10 immutable persistence/export, RBAC-secured API upload/read paths, and dependency-free draggable canvas viewer in the chat workspace; ./forge verify passed 247 tests, Ruff, strict mypy, lock/pip checks and 90% coverage.

goals.title: Eighty-percent pilot integration and final gates
goals.objective: Integrate the new backend and chat-first frontend surfaces, update PRD/DESIGN/README status honestly, run full verification, browser responsive QA, cleanup and independent code/architecture review; quantify remaining production gaps without conflating coverage with product completion.
goals.evidence: Integrated RBAC/audit, operational health/verified backup/non-overwrite restore, project-scoped cited local RAG with English/Korean release-authority guard and up to three source citations, bounded ASCII/binary STL persistence plus contextual 3D canvas, and GPT-style chat-first UX. README/PRD/DESIGN quantify local deployment-pilot completeness conservatively at about 80% and explicitly gate hosted LLM, STEP/SolidWorks/CAE/device/live enterprise connectors, SSO and multitenancy. Browser desktop/mobile/STL QA passed; ./forge verify passed Ruff, format, strict mypy, lock/pip, 250 tests and 90% coverage; independent code review APPROVE with zero findings and architect CLEAR.

goals.title: GitHub App guided integration
goals.objective: Add an in-product settings experience that securely configures and tests a read-only GitHub App connection, collects repository commit/change/PR/Actions evidence with exact provenance, adds CI verification, and validates the end-to-end local operator flow.
goals.evidence: Implemented secure read-only GitHub App Settings, credential test/connect/status/sync routes, exact commit/PR/Actions provenance, local key integrity boundaries, GitHub Actions verification workflow, 262 passing tests at 90% coverage, and desktop browser QA with 22 provider cards and zero console errors.

goals.title: Universal engineering Integration Hub
goals.objective: Generalize the GitHub settings work into a secure Integration Hub with typed provider catalog, pluggable read-only driver contracts, credential boundaries, connection status APIs, and GPT-style settings surfaces for Git, PLM, CAD, CAE, CI, BOM suppliers, LLM/RAG, and robot/bench/HIL systems; keep unimplemented drivers explicitly unavailable and use GitHub as the first live driver.
goals.evidence: Independent code-reviewer found P1-equivalent: raw_files[:100] silently truncates while stats.total is line changes, not file count; also requested explicit freshness state and malformed Content-Length handling.

goals.title: Resolve GitHub changed-file completeness blocker
goals.objective: Make GitHub commit evidence fail closed on incomplete pagination, report actual changed-file counts, reject malformed upstream lengths, and verify stale/fresh evidence state before final review.
goals.evidence: Independent code-reviewer REQUEST_CHANGES: GitHub credential/evidence POST routes lacked the documented idempotency contract; PR and Actions evidence silently sealed only the first 20 results; workflow conclusion coercion and transient test-key staging were nonblocking hardening findings.

goals.title: Resolve final GitHub mutation and collection blockers
goals.objective: Add explicit idempotency for persistent GitHub integration mutations, collect pull-request and exact-SHA Actions evidence completely within fail-closed bounds, strictly validate workflow conclusions, document transient credential-test staging, and repeat all final quality gates.
goals.evidence: Independent code reviewer REQUEST_CHANGES: arbitrary workflow status/conclusion strings were accepted; workflow run pagination exceeded GitHub official 1000-result search cap; connect and sync could persist their mutation before the idempotency result, so a crash could cause a retry to repeat upstream work. Architect review was otherwise CLEAR.

goals.title: Resolve final GitHub durability and Actions contract blockers
goals.objective: Enforce official GitHub Actions status and conclusion contracts, fail closed at the official 1000-run search cap, make connect and sync idempotency crash-recoverable without repeated upstream calls, add regression tests and documentation, rerun full verification and the mandatory independent final reviews.
goals.evidence: G027 complete: strict official GitHub Actions status/conclusion validation; fail-closed 1,000-run exact-SHA cap; prepared/completed crash recovery for connect and sync; orphan key cleanup; docs and regression coverage. Post-cleaner ./forge verify passed Ruff, format, strict mypy, lock/pip checks, 279 tests and 90% coverage. Independent code review APPROVE with zero findings and architect CLEAR.

goals.evidence: README and current code show only local stdio MCP and deterministic local retrieval.

goals.evidence: Current implementation only parses STL; DESIGN lists STEP/SolidWorks parsing as missing.

goals.evidence: Current simulation is a fixture and the Integration Hub lists CAE providers as adapter required.

goals.evidence: 72 tests passed; 96% branch coverage; Ruff, mypy, lock check, pip check passed; immutable ApprovalRef, PreparedAnalysis, and append-only RunStateEvent contracts added; Git baseline commit 997621c created.

goals.title: Two-stage analysis engine
goals.objective: Split analysis into durable prepare and execute_prepared stages while preserving the existing execute wrapper; bind preflight to spec, revision, policy, engine, plugin, expected metrics, and approvals; reject stale or tampered preparation before plugin execution.
goals.evidence: 83 tests passed; 96% branch coverage; Ruff, formatting, mypy, lock and pip checks passed; independent re-review APPROVE; durable prepare/execute_prepared binding rejects stale or tampered state before plugin execution.

goals.title: SQLite evidence store
goals.objective: Implement migration-managed SQLite persistence for projects, specs, revisions, approvals, prepared analyses, append-only run events, results, idempotency, optimistic concurrency, startup recovery, and byte-stable evidence export.
goals.evidence: Implemented migration-managed SQLite persistence with WAL/FK/bounded retries, optimistic CAS, atomic domain+idempotency transactions, immutable specs/revisions/approvals/preparations/run events/results/evidence, validated startup-recovery discovery, corrupt row/payload rejection, and byte-stable snapshot export. ./forge verify passed: Ruff, strict mypy, lock checks, 102 tests, 93% total coverage. Independent code review APPROVE and architecture verification CLEAR.

goals.title: Application workflow service
goals.objective: Implement the only state-transition and engineering-evaluation owner, including draft-to-approved specs, revision-aware invalidation, prepared run orchestration without holding a database transaction during plugin execution, retry, cancellation boundaries, cost provenance, and maturity gating.
goals.steeringEvidence: User explicitly repositioned FORGE as an engineering change-management AI and evidence-based release validation layer connecting CAD, PLM, Git, and CI instead of a general AI engineer.
goals.steeringRationale: The active general workflow-service story is too broad and product-misaligned; replace it with focused domain, impact-analysis, and release-readiness stories while preserving completed deterministic contracts and persistence.

goals.title: Engineering change domain and positioning
goals.objective: Reframe FORGE as the validation layer connecting existing CAD, PLM, Git, and CI; define versioned contracts and source-of-truth documentation for hardware revisions, cross-artifact consistency findings, retest requirements, evidence tiers, and release decisions without replacing authoring systems.
goals.evidence: PRD v4 and README now define FORGE as a read-only validation layer connecting CAD/PLM/Git/CI; forge_core/change_management.py adds source snapshots, cross-domain impacts, findings, explicit evidence tiers, retest requirements, and deterministic READY/BLOCKED contracts; ./forge verify passed 110 tests with 91% total branch coverage.

goals.title: Cross-artifact change impact engine
goals.objective: Detect hardware revision changes and deterministically map them to affected firmware, BOM, tests, protocol schemas, and documentation; validate pins, voltage, units, command ranges, and protocol compatibility; automatically assign required retests with explicit reasons.
goals.evidence: forge_core/impact_engine.py implements deterministic source-bound hardware revision delta detection, cross-artifact pin/voltage/unit/command/schema validation, fail-closed policy coverage, and exact-tier automatic retest assignment; tests/test_impact_engine.py covers 20 adversarial cases; ./forge verify passed 130 tests with 91% total coverage; independent re-review found no P0/P1 and judged G009 checkpoint-ready (one non-blocking P2: one canonical projection per domain).

goals.title: Evidence-based release readiness service
goals.objective: Collect source- and timestamp-bound BOM prices, firmware build and test results, and distinctly typed simulation, bench, HIL, and physical-device evidence; issue release-ready or blocked decisions with traceable blockers and a reproducible report.
goals.evidence: Implemented evidence-based release readiness with source/timestamp-bound BOM cost, firmware build and exact-tier test evidence; explicit simulation/bench/HIL/physical-device bindings; deterministic READY/BLOCKED report; target protocol schema, firmware source/build artifact, BOM snapshot membership, freshness, and assessment/retest provenance validation. ./forge verify passed Ruff, format, strict mypy, lock/pip checks, 139 tests, and 90% branch coverage. Independent adversarial re-review found no P0/P1 and approved checkpoint; append-only ReleaseDecision persistence remains a G005 P2/WATCH required before G007.

goals.title: Secure integration and release API
goals.objective: Expose change intake, connector snapshots, consistency findings, required retests, evidence ingestion, and release decisions through a secure loopback API; define adapter boundaries for CAD, PLM, Git, and CI without becoming a source-of-truth replacement, and retain idempotency, optimistic concurrency, Origin/Host/CSRF/content-type/body-limit protections.
goals.steeringEvidence: User positioned FORGE as a connecting verification layer for existing engineering systems.
goals.steeringRationale: The API must center change-management and release evidence rather than generic spec execution.
goals.evidence: Implemented secure loopback engineering release API with read-only CAD/PLM/Git/CI connector boundaries and persisted capture provenance; immutable per-project release policy with v1/v2->v3 backfill; project-scoped append-only raw evidence and decisions; canonical hash binding for policy and selected evidence; idempotency, optimistic concurrency, exact Host/Origin/CSRF/content-type/body limits; BOM policy/timestamp ambiguity fail-closed. ./forge verify passed Ruff, strict mypy, lock/pip checks, 164 tests and 90% total branch coverage. Two independent final reviewers returned GO with no P0/P1.

goals.title: Engineering release readiness dashboard
goals.objective: Build a thin operator interface showing hardware revision deltas, cross-artifact mismatches, automatically required retests, provenance-bound BOM prices, firmware/build/test evidence, explicit simulation-versus-bench-versus-HIL-versus-device tiers, and release-ready or blocked decisions with drill-down reasons.
goals.steeringEvidence: User explicitly requested evidence-based release readiness and clear separation of verification environments.
goals.steeringRationale: The operator experience should answer what changed, what is inconsistent, what must be rerun, and why release is blocked.
goals.evidence: Implemented a thin read-only engineering release dashboard at /app/ with hardware deltas, cross-artifact findings, auto-retests, provenance-bound BOM quotes/timestamps, firmware build/test evidence, explicit static/simulation/bench/HIL/physical-device lanes, READY/BLOCKED reasons, and canonical hash drill-down. Loopback-only server uses strict Host/Origin validation, asset allowlist, CSP without inline code, safe DOM rendering, and packaged same-origin assets. Browser QA verified READY, BLOCKED, not_found, 1440px and 390px layouts with no horizontal overflow or console errors. Wheel asset inclusion verified. ./forge verify passed Ruff, strict mypy, lock/pip checks, 170 tests and 90% coverage. Two independent final reviewers returned GO with no P0/P1 after project-ID contract regression fix.
